To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

6-substituted 2,3-dicyano -5-[4-(dimethylamino) styryl]-7 -methyl-6H -1,4 -diazepines (1a -c) exhibit intense fluorescence in solid state and that the fluorescence intensity is strongly affected by the 6-substituents.

(1) The 6-substituents of 2, 3-dicyano5-[4-(dialkylamino)-styyl]-7-methyl6H-1.4-diazepine derivatives can effectively suppress the cofacial molecular stacking, and (2) the 6-alkylthio derivatives show intense fluorescence in solid state, which is attributed to the steric repulsion between the 6- alkylthio substituents.

2,3- dicyano-5- [4-(diethylamine)-styryl] -7-methyl- 6H -1,4-diaze-pine derivatives were successfully synthesized, characterized and their photophysical and electrochemical properties were studied. 2,3,4,6,7,11b-hexahydro-5H-2,3-diphenyl-1,4-benzodiazepin-5-ones were synthesized
In summary, our research is concerned with
the synthesis, characterization, and fluorescence properties of 6-substituted 2,3-dicyano -5-[4-( diethylamino)- styryl]-7- methyl-6H- 1,4-diaze- pines (1-6).
the synthesis, characterization and fluorescence properties of a series of 2,2′-(1,4-dioxane-2,3-diyldimethyl)bis-6-(4-substituted phenyl)-2,3-dicyno-5-[4- (diethylamino)]-7-methyl-1,4- diazepine.
the fluorescence spectra of 2,2'-bipyridine and 1,10-phenanthroline in solid state, and the fluorescence of 2-phenylpyridine in the solid state.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the 6-substituents have a significant effect on the solid-state emission properties of 2,4-dicyano-6-aryl-5-[4-diethylamino)styril]-7-methyl 1,4-diaze-pine derivatives, but not on their solution emission properties.
the fluorescence intensity of 6- substituted 2,3- dicyano-5- [4- (diethylamino ) styryl]-7- methyl-6H- 1,4- diazepines is enhanced in solid state.

the bulky substituents on the 6-position of 2, 3-dicyano 7-methyl-5-(4-diethylaminostyryl)-6H-1-4-diazepine derivatives have a great influence on the molecular stacking and the fluorescence intensity of 2,2-dicyano-7-methyl-1-4-5,5-diphenyl-6H-6H-4-diazapines.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
6-substituted 2-3-dicyano5-[4-(dialkylamino) styryl]-7methyl6H-1-4-diazepine derivatives are promising materials for organic solid state fluorescence materials.

6-methoxy derivative showed the most intense fluorescence in solid state, and that the fluorescence intensity in solid state was in good correlation with the energy gap between the first excited singlet and ground state, which is a measure of the electron donating ability of the substituents.

the fluorescence of the 6-substituted 2-DCDASMs is more sensitive to the molecular packing than the 6-unsubstituted 2DCDASM, which is a good indicator that the 2DCDASMs in solid state are in the cofacial stacking mode.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the 2,3-disubstituted 7-methyl-1,4-benzodiazepines can be synthesized in high yield and purity.
6-substituted 2-3-dicyano 5-[4-(Diethylamino) styryl]-7- methyl-6H- 1,4-diazipines in solid state have intense fluorescence.
6-phenyl-2,3-dicayno-5-[4- (diethylamino)syryl]-7- methyl-6H- 1,4- diazepine is the most suitable candidate for the development of a solid state fluorescent material.
